## In plain English

Upstream rebuilt one or more of the third-party images we pin by digest, so the committed digests
drifted from what their tags now resolve to. This automated PR (opened by the scheduled
`cd-thirdparty-digest-audit` workflow) refreshes them to the current bytes. These are
reproducibility pins only — we do not sign these images, so nothing is cosign-verified here
(ADR-PC-007 §A3).

## Summary

- Re-resolved every pinned third-party tag with `crane` and updated the drifted `sha256` digests in
  the base/overlay kustomizations and the k3s-upgrade Plan.
- Generated by `scripts/cd-thirdparty-digest-audit.py --write`; review the diff to confirm each new
  digest is the tag you expect.

## Testing

- `kustomize build` + `kubeconform -strict` run in the CI infra job on this branch.
- `mise exec -- python3 scripts/cd-thirdparty-digest-audit.py --check` should now report all pins
  current and consistent.

## ADRs touched/honoured

- Honours **ADR-PC-007 §A3** (third-party images pinned by digest for reproducibility, not
  cosign-verified) and **ADR-IC-014** (the hand-rolled third-party digest-audit maintenance leg).

## bd issues closed on merge

- None — no bd issue is resolved by this PR.
